before: An m:nary without m:chr projected, drew, and copied as a sum, its compact linear text spelled a sum, and an equation with no compact linear text accepted compact replacement from an empty field.
after: An m:nary without m:chr projects, draws, and copies as an integral, offers no compact linear text, and keeps its source without m:chr. Copied text, Markdown, PDF text, and text fallbacks include the drawn operator of every n-ary structure. Compact replacement of an editable equation with no compact linear text is refused with a reason; removal stays available.
reason: Only the read-only projection of preserved source and a local capability check change. Each peer derives the refusal from the same canonical tree. Canonical OMML, offsets, operations, and collaboration data remain unchanged, and compact replacement still writes m:chr for each sum it creates.
